toolTipItems: Automatically banks resources obtained for Archaeology, Farming, Fishing, Mining and Woodcutting
10% chance to upgrade your Fishing, Mining, and Woodcutting resources to the next tier
Tree felling rate is reduced and woodcutting resumes automatically when the tree regrows
Automatically follow fishing spots when they move
Permanently full stamina when mining
Always-active time sprite when excavating
Doubles the resources obtained for Archaeology, Fishing, Mining and Woodcutting
Grants the Survivalist's Bag, holding up to 150 of three different types of logs, ores, or fish at once
Provides the highest tier tools for Mining (Pickaxe of the Faithful), Fishing (Harpoon of the Pious), and Woodcutting (Hatchet of Devotion)
Rockertunities and critical swings deal double damage
Rockertunities immediately provide an ore
Time sprite focus gain is doubled
Discovering artefacts or lore pages immediately grants 100% sprite focus
50% chance artefacts are automatically restored, also granting the restoration XP
Grants goldenhawk boots, offering passive Agility XP whilst moving, skilling, or using ultimate abilities
Chance to obtain goldenhawk feathers whilst training Agility or Thieving, which can be converted into Prayer XP or alchemised
Double base agility course XP and coins on completion, and prevents failures of obstacles and shortcuts
Guaranteed success on all Thieving pickpocketing attempts, with tripled and noted loot
Stalls never deplete and safes can be opened without a cooldown
Repeated Thieving actions continue automatically
All coins obtained via Thieving are increased by 100x, and chests and safes can reward bundles of herb and potion ingredients sent directly to your bank
